title: [2026-10-27-image-upscaling-methods] 01 · Image processing and upscaling options for page scans

plan.text: Keep three image tiers per page (checksummed master, cleaned, display) with recipe in manifest
Restrict AI super-resolution (Real-ESRGAN/SwinIR) to display images only
Side-by-side three-tier trial on sample clean and hard pages from the etceter4 repo (offered, not run)
Run HTR (Transkribus/TrOCR) on cleaned images as second opinion on the 306 uncertain readings
Decide whether the notebook can be rescanned at 600 dpi or more
